# Glossary

- <a id="term-arc"></a>**ARC**: Audio Return Channel, the HDMI path that carries TV audio to a soundbar.
- <a id="term-compatibility-mode"></a>**Compatibility mode**: Registration with an unsigned manifest. The integration switches to it when a webOS 26 TV rejects the signed manifest.
- <a id="term-pairing-key"></a>**Pairing key**: The client key a TV issues after you accept the pairing prompt. Home Assistant stores it in the config entry and sends it on every connection.
- <a id="term-ssap"></a>**SSAP**: Second Screen Application Protocol, the websocket API a webOS TV exposes to companion apps. The integration sends every command through it.
- <a id="term-wake-on-lan"></a>**Wake-on-LAN**: A UDP magic packet sent to the TV's MAC address. It is the only way to turn a webOS TV on from Home Assistant.
